title: MAI VIRAL ISOLATION
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather consumables and equipment
steps.instruction: Collect all required hardware and consumables listed for the MAI viral isolation protocol.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Open the protocol in the Opentrons Protocol Designer and input the required experimental parameters for the virus isolation run.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Export the completed protocol as a Python script (or JSON) and save it to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, use the “Upload” function to load the saved protocol file onto the OT‑2 robot.

steps.title: Arrange deck per deck map
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the OT‑2 deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map (e.g., tip rack, reservoir, magnetic module, and 96‑well plate).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the Opentrons App to calibrate the pipette, tip rack, and all deck slots using the supplied calibration tips.

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to execute the automated multi‑wash virus isolation, which includes custom shakes to release droplets from pipette tips.
